# Parkitect

> > Parkitect manufactures premium site furnishings including bike racks, benches, shelters, and bollards for public spaces and sustainable urban infrastructure.

Based in Isanti, MN, Parkitect specializes in outdoor furniture solutions for parks, transit stations, and urban environments. Their product line includes custom and sport-themed bike racks, secure bike lockers, decorative benches, and safety bollards designed for durability and modern aesthetics.

## Key Topics

- Bike racks and bicycle storage solutions
- Site furnishings and outdoor furniture
- Sustainable transportation infrastructure
- Custom bike rack designs
- Benches (Executive, Trainstop, Players, Commuter models)
- Bike lockers and vertical racks
- Urban planning and public spaces
- Powder coating and finishes
- Installation and mounting options
- Bollards and security solutions
- Skateboard racks
- Urban renewal case studies
- Anti-theft and vandalism prevention
- Sport-themed bike racks (Baseball, Basketball, Football, Soccer)
- Isanti, MN manufacturing location

## Bike Storage Solutions

- [Bike Racks | Parkitect](https://parkitect.com/bike-racks): Premium bike racks: Radius, Radius Pro, Radius Squared & Sunrise models
- [Custom Bike Racks | Parkitect](https://parkitect.com/custom-bike-racks): Custom bike racks: Book, Bookworm, Leaf & festive holiday designs
- [Sports Bike Racks | Parkitect](https://parkitect.com/sports-bike-racks): Sport-themed bike racks: Baseball, Basketball, Football & Soccer designs
- [Bike Lockers| Parkitect](https://parkitect.com/bike-lockers): Secure bike lockers: Single, Double & Pie models for long-term storage
- [Vertical Bike Racks](https://parkitect.com/vertical-bike-racks): Space-efficient vertical racks: Wall mount & freestanding models
- [Skateboard Racks | Parkitect](https://parkitect.com/skateboard-racks): Skateboard storage: Gondola combo, Sonic Wave & Tower rack models
